kiotviet.name: KiotViet
kiotviet.description: Sync products, stock per branch, orders and customers.

wizard.title: Connect KiotViet
wizard.retailerHelp: The part before .kiotviet.vn, e.g. shopabc. Pasting the full link works too.
wizard.secretHelp: Rapiz encrypts this secret and never shows it again.
whereSteps: Sign in to KiotViet with the store owner account.
Go to Settings → Store → API connection and click Edit.
Verify with your phone number, click Create and tick access to customers, invoices and orders.
Copy the Client ID and the client secret and paste them here.

errors.auth: The Client ID or client secret is wrong. Check them in KiotViet → API connection settings.
errors.retailer: This store was not found. The store name is the part before .kiotviet.vn.
errors.retailerChanged: The new credentials belong to another store. To switch stores, disconnect and connect again.
errors.permission: The API account is missing permissions: {{list}}. Tick them in KiotViet and try again.
errors.unavailable: KiotViet is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.busy: KiotViet is busy, try again in a minute.
errors.branch: A branch no longer exists in KiotViet. Reload the list and choose again.
errors.orderBranchRequired: Choose the order branch among the selected branches.
errors.noBranches: The store has no branches in KiotViet yet.
errors.alreadyConnected: This business is already connected to KiotViet.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again later.

wizard.branchesHelp: The bot reports stock as the total left across the branches you choose.
wizard.orderBranchHelp: Orders closed in Rapiz go to this branch.
wizard.preview: {{matched}} products match by code · {{created}} new products · {{rapizOnly}} products only in Rapiz (kept)
wizard.previewPartial: {{matched}} products match by code · {{created}} new products (in the first {{scanned}}/{{total}} products)
wizard.sourceNote: Once connected, the name, price, pictures and stock of linked products are edited in KiotViet. Bot-specific settings are still edited in Rapiz.
wizard.connected: KiotViet connected. Products are being imported.
wizard.notConnected: This business is not connected to KiotViet. The owner or an admin can connect it.

progress.leave: You can leave this page; the sync keeps running.

connection.conflict: The connection was just changed elsewhere. It has been reloaded; try again.
connection.updateCredentialsHelp: Paste the new Client ID and client secret of the same KiotViet store.
connection.dangerHelp: Synced data is kept. Products become Rapiz products and can be edited as usual.

log.image_failed: {{count}} pictures could not be loaded (JPEG/PNG only)
log.sku_conflict: Code {{sku}} is used by another Rapiz product — change it on one side to link them
log.auth_failed: KiotViet rejected the client secret — it may have been changed. Click Update credentials.
log.kiotviet_unavailable: KiotViet is not responding, will retry
log.webhook_register_failed: Could not register instant updates — still syncing every 10 minutes
log.webhook_unknown: Ignored an unknown notification from KiotViet
log.sweep_capped: {{count}} more products will be checked again on the next sync
log.connect_failed: The connection did not finish setting up, so it cannot sync. Disconnect, then connect again to retry.
log.order_push_failed: Could not push order {{code}} to KiotViet — open the order to see why, then Retry
log.order_push_duplicate: Order {{code}} was already in KiotViet, so KiotViet now has an extra copy — cancel the extra order in KiotViet (no need to Retry)
log.order_pushed_cancelled: Order {{code}} was cancelled in Rapiz but is already in KiotViet — cancel it in KiotViet
log.customer_push_failed: Could not create a customer in KiotViet — turn customer sync off and on again to retry
log.customers_permission_missing: The API account has no customer permission, so customer sync was turned off — in KiotViet open API connection settings (Thiết lập kết nối API), tick the Customers permission, then turn customer sync back on
log.customers_import_failed: Could not sync customers from KiotViet — Rapiz tries again at the next sync; orders and stock carry on

crm.fieldHint: Synced from KiotViet — edit it in KiotViet to keep the change
crm.rapizBadgeLabel: Customer linked to a Rapiz account
crm.rapizFieldHint: Phone and email come from the Rapiz account and cannot be edited here
